generic.Defined scope/population: Reserving segments and accident years touched by the listed structural changes are named as in scope.
generic.In-scope period: Accident years from the earliest affected vintage through the current evaluation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every adjustment layer carries change type, effective date, affected segment and adjustment factor.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Latest-diagonal paid and incurred totals on the adjusted triangle equal the unadjusted totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Adjusted and unadjusted Arius triangle versions saved with run timestamp and evaluation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Structural changes reviewed but not adjusted for are logged with the reason for no adjustment.
generic.Test population: All structural adjustment layers applied in Arius for the current evaluation date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero movement in latest-diagonal totals and every LDF delta by maturity explained.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained diagonal movement returns the layer to the Reserving Analyst for rework before selection.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each layer names its structural change, basis, effective date and affected accident years.
generic.Evidence location: Arius adjustment layer log plus the assumption log in the quarter reserve cycle folder.

steps.title: Compile the structural change register in Microsoft Excel
sop: List system conversions, case-reserve strengthening, coverage or limit changes and segment remaps.
Record the effective date and the affected segments for each change.
Confirm each entry with claims, underwriting or reinsurance as the source of the change.
Done when the register lists every structural change in scope with effective dates.
verify: Check each register row has a change type, effective date and affected segment.
Pass when no known structural change for the period is missing from the register.

steps.title: Quantify the on-level or exposure basis for each change in Microsoft Excel
sop: Choose the adjustment basis: on-level premium, exposure re-rating or claim-count re-basing.
Compute the adjustment factor by accident year for each affected segment.
Sanity-check factors against the size of the underlying business change.
Done when an adjustment factor by accident year exists for every change in scope.
verify: Recompute two factors independently from the source exposure data.
Pass when both recomputed factors match the workbook to the stated rounding.

steps.title: Apply the adjustment as a named layer in Milliman Arius
sop: Create a named adjustment layer in Arius rather than overtyping triangle cells.
Attach the effective date, basis and rationale text to the layer.
Apply the layer only to the accident years identified in the register.
Done when every change in the register exists as a named Arius layer.
verify: Open each layer and confirm effective date and rationale text are populated.
Pass when no triangle cell was edited outside an adjustment layer.

steps.title: Rerun age-to-age factors on adjusted and unadjusted triangles in Milliman Arius
sop: Rerun the factor calculation on both the adjusted and the unadjusted triangle sets.
Export both factor grids to Microsoft Excel for side-by-side comparison.
Compute the LDF delta by maturity and by segment.
Done when the LDF delta grid is produced for every adjusted segment.
verify: Check the delta grid covers every maturity for every adjusted segment.
Pass when each delta larger than the segment tolerance has a written driver.

steps.title: Prove the latest diagonal is unchanged in Microsoft Excel
sop: Pull latest-diagonal paid and incurred totals from both triangle versions.
Difference the two sets by segment and by accident year.
Investigate any non-zero difference back to the layer that caused it.
Done when the diagonal difference is zero or fully explained.
verify: Recompute the diagonal totals from the source claims extract totals.
Pass when adjusted and unadjusted diagonals both agree to the source extract.

steps.title: Record the adjustment in the assumption log
sop: Write one assumption log entry per adjustment layer with basis and affected accident years.
Cross-reference the entry to the Arius layer name and the LDF delta exhibit.
Note any structural change deliberately left unadjusted and why.
Done when the assumption log matches the applied Arius layers one for one.
verify: Compare the Arius layer list to the assumption log entries.
Pass when every applied layer has a matching dated log entry.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every age-to-age column and the tail for each reserving segment requiring a factor selection this cycle.
generic.In-scope period: Development maturities from 12 months to the last observed age at the current evaluation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each selected factor carries a basis label, the averaging window and any override note.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cumulative development factors compound through to the selected tail at every maturity.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Arius selection set saved under the evaluation-date version with the averaging exhibits attached.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Selections outside the displayed average range are logged with the judgement applied.
generic.Test population: All selected age-to-age and tail factors for the evaluation date across every segment.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Prior-quarter movement beyond the agreed tolerance requires a written explanation.
generic.Exception handling path: A selection left at system default without an override note is returned for reselection.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every factor has a stated selection basis and the tail method is named and evidenced.
generic.Evidence location: Arius selection exhibits and the factor selection workbook in the reserve cycle folder.

steps.title: Produce the averaging grid for every age-to-age column in Milliman Arius
sop: Generate volume-weighted, simple, 3-year, 5-year and ex-high/ex-low averages per column.
Show the number of observations behind each average.
Export the grid to Microsoft Excel for the selection working paper.
Done when all five averaging bases exist for every maturity and segment.
verify: Recalculate one column of averages in Microsoft Excel from the raw factors.
Pass when the recalculated averages match the Arius grid.

steps.title: Select the age-to-age factor per maturity in Milliman Arius
sop: Choose the factor for each maturity and tag it with the averaging basis used.
Flag any selection falling outside the range of displayed averages.
Add a judgement note wherever the selection is not a displayed average.
Done when every maturity carries a selected factor with a basis label.
verify: List selections lacking a basis label or a judgement note.
Pass when that list is empty for every segment.

steps.title: Fit and select the tail factor in Milliman Arius
sop: Fit the candidate tail curves and compare them to the benchmark tail for the line.
Select the tail factor and record the fitting method and the data used.
State the maturity at which the tail takes over from observed factors.
Done when a tail factor with a named method exists for every segment.
verify: Check the recorded method matches the curve or benchmark actually used.
Pass when no segment carries a tail without a named selection method.

steps.title: Verify cumulative factors compound to the tail in Microsoft Excel
sop: Chain the selected age-to-age factors from each maturity through to ultimate.
Confirm the compounded result equals the cumulative factor shown by Arius.
Check the implied percent-of-ultimate is monotonic across maturities.
Done when the compounding check passes for every segment.
verify: Recompute two segments end to end in Microsoft Excel.
Pass when compounded and Arius cumulative factors agree to the stated rounding.

steps.title: Compare selections to prior quarter in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load prior-quarter selected factors and difference them against the current selections.
Flag every maturity moving more than the agreed segment tolerance.
Draft the driver for each flagged movement from the observed experience.
Done when every flagged movement carries a draft explanation.
verify: Check the comparison covers every segment and maturity selected last quarter.
Pass when no flagged movement lacks an explanation.

steps.title: Lock and document the selection set in Milliman Arius
sop: Review the flagged movements and confirm or amend the selections.
Lock the selection set under the evaluation-date version tag.
File the averaging grid, tail memo and movement comparison as the working paper.
Done when the locked selection set is released for the indication run.
verify: Confirm the locked version identifier matches the working paper set.
Pass when no indication run uses an unlocked selection set.

generic.Defined scope/population: Raw claims extract, transformation query and triangle output files for every segment this cycle.
generic.In-scope period: The current quarter evaluation date archive folder in the document management repository.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each archived file carries evaluation date, segment, extract timestamp and record count metadata.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived record counts equal the counts logged in the extract register.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Files stored with the source system snapshot identifier so the extract can be reproduced.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Files archived without full metadata are listed and completed before folder lock.
generic.Test population: All files placed in the quarter-dated archive folder for the evaluation date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every archived file carries complete version metadata before the folder is set read-only.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing metadata blocks read-only lock and returns the file to the Data Analyst.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Extract, transformation and triangle files present and indexed in the reserve cycle index.
generic.Evidence location: Quarter-dated folder in the document management repository plus the reserve cycle index.

steps.title: Export the raw claims extract from the data warehouse/lake
sop: Re-export the frozen snapshot extract used to build this quarter triangles.
Capture the snapshot identifier and the row count at export.
Save the file to the quarter-dated archive folder in the document management repository.
Done when the raw extract file is in the archive folder with its row count noted.
verify: Compare the exported row count to the extract register entry.
Pass when the counts agree exactly.

steps.title: Archive the transformation query from the data warehouse/lake
sop: Export the transformation query or notebook that produced the triangle input.
Include any parameter values and segment mapping tables it references.
Store it beside the raw extract in the same archive folder.
Done when the transformation logic is archived in runnable form.
verify: Rerun the archived query against the snapshot in a test schema.
Pass when the rerun reproduces the archived triangle input row count.

steps.title: Archive the triangle output files to the document management repository
sop: Copy the released triangle files for every segment into the archive folder.
Confirm the files match the version released to downstream teams.
Group the files by segment inside the quarter folder.
Done when every released segment triangle is archived.
verify: Compare the archived triangle set to the released distribution list.
Pass when no released segment is missing from the archive.

steps.title: Stamp version metadata onto each archived file
sop: Populate evaluation date, segment, extract timestamp and record count in the file properties.
Record the source system snapshot identifier alongside the extract file.
Use the standard naming convention so files sort by evaluation date.
Done when no file in the folder lacks version metadata.
verify: Run the metadata report over the archive folder.
Pass when the report returns zero files with missing metadata fields.

steps.title: Log the archive path in the reserve cycle index
sop: Add the archive folder path against the evaluation date in the cycle index.
List which files the folder contains and the snapshot identifier.
Note the retention class applied to the folder.
Done when the cycle index entry points at the archive folder.
verify: Open the index entry and follow the path to the folder.
Pass when the path resolves and the file list matches the folder contents.

steps.title: Set the archive folder to read-only after sign-off
sop: Confirm the reserve cycle has been signed off before locking.
Apply read-only permissions to the quarter archive folder.
Confirm reserving staff retain read access for future reference.
Done when the folder is read-only and access is confirmed.
verify: Attempt a test write to the locked folder with a standard account.
Pass when the write is refused and read access still works.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every reserving segment carrying a selected tail factor at the current evaluation date.
generic.In-scope period: The industry Schedule P development vintage matching the current evaluation year.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each comparison records benchmark source, vintage, mapped line and the variance measured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Implied percent-of-ultimate at the last observed maturity ties to the selected tail.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Benchmark pull and comparison workbook saved with the evaluation date and source vintage.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Variances beyond threshold are logged with a company-specific driver or accepted with reason.
generic.Test population: All selected tail factors compared against a mapped industry development schedule.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Variance beyond the agreed threshold requires a documented company-specific driver.
generic.Exception handling path: An unexplained variance returns the tail selection to the Reserving Actuary for review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Tail selection memo records benchmark source, vintage, mapping and variance explanation.
generic.Evidence location: Tail selection memo and the benchmark comparison workbook in the reserve cycle folder.

steps.title: Pull the industry development pattern from Statutory Reporting (NAIC)
sop: Download the Schedule P development pattern for each matching line of business.
Record the data vintage and the source publication date.
Load the pattern into Microsoft Excel on the same maturity grain as the company triangles.
Done when an industry pattern exists for every line to be benchmarked.
verify: Check the vintage recorded matches the downloaded file.
Pass when every pattern has a stated source and vintage.

steps.title: Map company reserving segments to industry lines in Microsoft Excel
sop: Map each reserving segment to the closest Schedule P line of business.
Note where a segment spans more than one line or mixes limits profiles.
Record the mapping compromise so the variance can be read in context.
Done when every segment has a documented industry mapping.
verify: Review the mapping with the Reserving Actuary against the segment definitions.
Pass when no segment is benchmarked to a line it does not map to.

steps.title: Compare selected tail and percent-of-ultimate to the benchmark in Microsoft Excel
sop: Place the selected tail factor beside the benchmark tail for each mapped line.
Compare the implied percent-of-ultimate at the last observed maturity.
Compute the variance in factor terms and in ultimate dollar terms.
Done when the variance is quantified for every segment.
verify: Recompute one segment percent-of-ultimate from the Arius cumulative factors.
Pass when the recomputed value matches the comparison exhibit.

steps.title: Explain variances beyond threshold in Microsoft Excel
sop: Identify variances above the agreed threshold for the segment.
Attribute each to limits profile, business mix, jurisdiction or claim practice.
Support the attribution with company data rather than assertion.
Done when every threshold variance carries an evidenced driver.
verify: Check each explanation cites a company data point or exhibit.
Pass when no threshold variance rests on assertion alone.

steps.title: Quantify the ultimate impact of adopting the benchmark tail in Milliman Arius
sop: Run a sensitivity replacing the selected tail with the benchmark tail.
Record the change in indicated ultimate by segment.
Note whether the sensitivity falls inside the range of reasonable estimates.
Done when the benchmark sensitivity result is recorded per segment.
verify: Confirm the sensitivity run used the approved triangle version.
Pass when the run identifier matches the current evaluation-date version.

steps.title: Write the tail selection memo
sop: Record the accepted tail, the benchmark comparison and the sensitivity result.
State the conclusion: benchmark supports, challenges or is inconclusive for each segment.
File the memo with the factor selection working paper.
Done when the memo covers every segment carrying a tail factor.
verify: Cross-check the memo segment list against the selection set.
Pass when no selected tail lacks a documented benchmark comparison.

generic.Defined scope/population: Paid, incurred, case-reserve and claim-count triangles for every reserving segment.
generic.In-scope period: Accident periods from the earliest retained vintage to the current evaluation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every triangle cell carries segment, accident period, development age and a numeric value.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Latest diagonal equals the claims extract totals for paid, incurred and counts.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Triangle set tagged with evaluation date, segment and extract identifier before release.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Negative or non-monotonic cumulative cells are listed with a disposition each.
generic.Test population: All triangles generated in Arius for the current evaluation date across every segment.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero difference between latest diagonal and extract totals for each measure.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained negative cumulative paid cells block release until dispositioned.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Four triangle types exist per segment on the agreed accident and development grain.
generic.Evidence location: Arius triangle set for the evaluation date plus the build workbook in Microsoft Excel.

steps.title: Load the certified claims extract into Milliman Arius from the data warehouse/lake
sop: Import the frozen extract for the evaluation date into the Arius data set.
Confirm the extract identifier matches the one in the extract register.
Check the segment mapping applied on load is the current approved mapping.
Done when the extract is loaded and its identifier is recorded.
verify: Compare loaded row count and paid sum to the extract register control totals.
Pass when both agree exactly.

steps.title: Set the accident and development grain in Milliman Arius
sop: Set the accident-period basis and the development age interval for each segment.
Use accident quarter only where claim volume supports the finer grain.
Record the grain applied against each segment.
Done when every segment has an assigned grain in the Arius data set.
verify: Compare the assigned grain to the documented cut-off decisions.
Pass when no segment differs from the approved grain without a note.

steps.title: Generate paid, incurred, case and count triangles in Milliman Arius
sop: Build cumulative paid, incurred, case-reserve and reported-count triangles per segment.
Confirm each triangle spans the full retained accident period history.
Export the set to Microsoft Excel for the review pack.
Done when four triangle types exist for every reserving segment.
verify: List segments and count the triangle types produced for each.
Pass when no segment has fewer than four triangle types.

steps.title: Reconcile the latest diagonal to the extract in Microsoft Excel
sop: Sum the latest diagonal for paid, incurred and counts by segment.
Compare against the extract control totals from the register.
Investigate any difference back to mapping or filter logic.
Done when the diagonal ties to the extract for all three measures.
verify: Recompute the totals directly from the warehouse extract.
Pass when triangle diagonal and extract totals agree to zero difference.

steps.title: Screen for negative and non-monotonic cells in Microsoft Excel
sop: Scan every triangle for negative cumulative values and for decreasing cumulative paid.
List each exception with segment, accident period and development age.
Assign a cause: recovery, subrogation, correction or data defect.
Done when every exception carries a stated cause.
verify: Rerun the scan after dispositions are entered.
Pass when no negative cumulative paid cell remains without an explanation.

steps.title: Tag and release the triangle set in Milliman Arius
sop: Review the exception list and the diagonal reconciliation before release.
Tag the triangle set with evaluation date, segment and extract identifier.
Release the tagged set as the basis for factor selection.
Done when the tagged triangle set is released for the cycle.
verify: Open the released set and confirm the tags are present and correct.
Pass when the released tag matches the extract register identifier.

generic.Defined scope/population: Accident-period basis, evaluation cut-off and retained maturity for every reserving segment.
generic.In-scope period: The current reserving cycle and the quarter from which any changed cut-off takes effect.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each segment records period basis, evaluation cut-off date and maximum development age.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Evaluation cut-off matches the claims close date and the general ledger close date.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Cut-off decisions versioned in the methodology document with an effective quarter.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments differing from the prior cycle grain are logged with the quantified effect.
generic.Test population: All reserving segments with a cut-off decision recorded for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No segment may use an evaluation date other than the claims close date.
generic.Exception handling path: A mismatched cut-off is escalated to the Reserving Actuary before triangles are built.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accident-period basis and evaluation cut-off recorded and approved for every segment.
generic.Evidence location: Triangle methodology document and the cut-off decision table in Microsoft Excel.

steps.title: Set the accident-period basis per segment in Microsoft Excel
sop: Choose accident year, accident quarter, policy year or report year for each segment.
Base the choice on claim volume, coverage trigger and how the business is priced.
Record the basis and the reason against each segment.
Done when every segment carries a stated accident-period basis.
verify: Check the basis against the coverage trigger for two claims-made segments.
Pass when no segment uses a basis inconsistent with its coverage trigger.

steps.title: Confirm the evaluation cut-off against the close calendar
sop: Obtain the claims system close date and the general ledger close date for the period.
Set the triangle evaluation cut-off to the same date.
Note any segment where a different cut-off is unavoidable and why.
Done when the cut-off date is agreed and recorded for the cycle.
verify: Compare the recorded cut-off to the published close calendar.
Pass when the dates match for every segment.

steps.title: Set the maximum retained development age in Milliman Arius
sop: Decide the last development age retained in the observed triangle per segment.
Set the maturity at which the tail factor takes over.
Confirm the retained history is long enough for the segment settlement pattern.
Done when maximum age and tail hand-over maturity are set per segment.
verify: Check the hand-over maturity against the observed factor stability.
Pass when no segment hands over to tail while factors are still material.

steps.title: Quantify the impact of any grain change in Milliman Arius
sop: Identify segments whose grain or cut-off differs from the prior cycle.
Rerun the indication on both the old and the new grain.
Record the change in indicated ultimate caused by the grain change alone.
Done when every grain change carries a quantified impact.
verify: Confirm both runs used the same underlying extract.
Pass when the impact is attributable to grain and nothing else.

steps.title: Record the cut-off decisions in the methodology document
sop: Write the basis, cut-off, maximum age and tail hand-over into the methodology document.
State the effective quarter for any changed decision.
Cross-reference the quantified impact for changed segments.
Done when the methodology document reflects all current decisions.
verify: Compare the document to the decision table cell by cell.
Pass when the two agree for every segment.

steps.title: Publish the cut-off decisions to the triangle build
sop: Circulate the agreed cut-off table to everyone building triangles this cycle.
Apply the decisions in the Arius data set configuration.
Confirm no build starts before the decisions are published.
Done when the Arius configuration matches the published decision table.
verify: Spot-check three segment configurations in Arius against the table.
Pass when all three match the published decisions.

generic.Defined scope/population: The certified triangle package and every team on the standing reserve distribution list.
generic.In-scope period: The current evaluation date release window before the downstream pricing and capital cycles.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Package carries triangles, data quality certificate, reconciliation summary and change log.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Package version identifier equals the certified triangle set version identifier.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Release note and recipient list stored with release date in the document management repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Recipients added or removed from the standing list are logged with the approver.
generic.Test population: All release packages issued for the current evaluation date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No package may be distributed before data quality certification is signed.
generic.Exception handling path: An uncertified package is withheld and escalated to the Reserving Actuary.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Release note lists version, changed segments and recipients for the evaluation date.
generic.Evidence location: Release folder in the document management repository plus the reserve cycle index entry.

steps.title: Assemble the triangle package in the document management repository
sop: Collect the certified triangles, data quality certificate, reconciliation summary and change log.
Place them in the release folder for the evaluation date.
Remove any draft or superseded file from the folder.
Done when the release folder holds the four required components only.
verify: Check the folder contents against the package component list.
Pass when no component is missing and no draft file remains.

steps.title: Confirm the package version matches the certified triangle set
sop: Read the version identifier from the certified Arius triangle set.
Compare it to the identifier stamped on each package component.
Correct any component built on a superseded version.
Done when all components carry the same version identifier.
verify: List component version identifiers side by side.
Pass when all identifiers are identical.

steps.title: Draft the release note stating changed segments
sop: State which segments changed grain, definition or mapping this cycle.
Summarise the data quality limitations carried into the package.
Name the contact for questions and the deadline for feedback.
Done when the release note covers changes, limitations and contacts.
verify: Cross-check the changed-segment list against the cycle change log.
Pass when the note lists every segment recorded as changed.

steps.title: Obtain release approval from the Reserving Actuary
sop: Review the package components and the release note.
Confirm the data quality certificate is signed for this evaluation date.
Approve the release or return specific items for correction.
Done when the release approval is recorded against the package.
verify: Check the certificate signature date precedes the approval date.
Pass when certification precedes approval for the same version.

steps.title: Distribute the package via Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Send the package link to pricing, capital modelling, planning and financial reporting.
Use the standing distribution list rather than an ad hoc recipient set.
Include the release note text in the message body.
Done when all standing recipients have received the release.
verify: Compare sent recipients to the standing distribution list.
Pass when every standing recipient appears on the send record.

steps.title: Log the release in the reserve cycle index
sop: Record release date, version identifier and recipients against the evaluation date.
Link the index entry to the release folder path.
Note any recipient who received a restricted subset and why.
Done when the index entry is complete for the evaluation date.
verify: Open the index entry and follow the link to the release folder.
Pass when the entry resolves and matches the actual send record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Paid and incurred age-to-age factors for every reserving segment and maturity this cycle.
generic.In-scope period: All accident periods present in the released triangle set at the current evaluation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each commentary entry names segment, maturity range, observed pattern and volume caveat.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Implied percent-of-ultimate at each maturity ties to the selected factor pattern.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Write-up filed against the triangle version it describes with the evaluation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Factor outliers are listed with the distorting claim or calendar effect identified.
generic.Test population: All reserving segments in the released triangle set for the evaluation date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every outlier factor requires a narrative explanation before the write-up is filed.
generic.Exception handling path: An unexplained outlier is referred to the anomaly screening step for disposition.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Written pattern commentary exists per segment with the implied percent-of-ultimate stated.
generic.Evidence location: Pattern commentary document filed with the triangle version in the reserve cycle folder.

steps.title: Tabulate age-to-age factors by accident period in Milliman Arius
sop: Export paid and incurred factor grids by accident period and maturity per segment.
Include the observation count behind each maturity column.
Load the grids into Microsoft Excel for commentary work.
Done when factor grids exist for paid and incurred for every segment.
verify: Check each grid covers every accident period in the triangle.
Pass when no accident period row is missing from a grid.

steps.title: Highlight the driving diagonals in Microsoft Excel
sop: Mark the diagonals that dominate each maturity average.
Identify any large loss or calendar-period effect distorting a diagonal.
Quantify the factor with and without the distorting item.
Done when every dominant diagonal is marked and quantified.
verify: Recompute one maturity average excluding the marked item.
Pass when the recomputed value matches the exhibit.

steps.title: Describe the pattern in words for each segment
sop: Characterise each segment pattern as speeding up, slowing, stable or volatile.
State the volume caveat where the factor rests on few observations.
Avoid describing a pattern the data does not support.
Done when every segment carries a written pattern description.
verify: Compare each description to the factor grid it describes.
Pass when no description contradicts its underlying grid.

steps.title: State implied percent-of-ultimate by maturity in Microsoft Excel
sop: Convert the selected cumulative factors into percent-of-ultimate at each maturity.
Show paid and incurred percent-of-ultimate side by side.
Flag maturities where paid and incurred imply very different completeness.
Done when percent-of-ultimate is stated for every maturity and segment.
verify: Recompute two maturities from the cumulative factors.
Pass when recomputed and stated values agree to the stated rounding.

steps.title: Review the commentary with the Reserving Actuary
sop: Read each segment commentary against the factor grid and the selections.
Challenge descriptions that overstate what the data shows.
Require an explanation for any outlier left without narrative.
Done when the commentary is accepted for every segment.
verify: List segments where outliers still lack narrative.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: File the write-up against the triangle version
sop: Stamp the write-up with the triangle version and evaluation date it describes.
File it with the factor selection working paper.
Link it from the reserve cycle index.
Done when the filed write-up is retrievable by evaluation date.
verify: Retrieve the write-up from the index by evaluation date.
Pass when the retrieved version matches the released triangle version.

generic.Defined scope/population: Data sources, mappings, cut-offs, averaging bases and judgements behind the triangle build.
generic.In-scope period: The current methodology version and its effective reserving cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Document records author, reviewer, effective date, sources, assumptions and limitations.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documented segment mapping matches the mapping applied in the Arius data set.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Versioned document stored in the model governance repository with change history.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Known data limitations are listed with the compensating judgement applied.
generic.Test population: The current methodology document version for the reserving cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No methodology version may be published without a data limitations section.
generic.Exception handling path: A missing limitation section blocks publication and returns the draft to the author.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Current version carries author, reviewer and effective date and is cross-referenced from the reserve report.
generic.Evidence location: Model governance repository version plus the copy in the document management repository.

steps.title: Describe data sources and extract logic in the document
sop: Name the claims source system, the warehouse layer and the extract query used.
Describe the claims-to-reserving-segment mapping and who owns it.
State how the frozen snapshot is taken and by whom.
Done when a reader could reproduce the extract from the description.
verify: Compare the described mapping to the mapping applied in Arius.
Pass when the documented and applied mappings agree.

steps.title: Document period basis and claim treatment rules
sop: State the accident-period basis and cut-offs applied per segment.
Describe the treatment of large losses, salvage and subrogation, and ALAE.
Explain how reopened claims and negative transactions are handled.
Done when every treatment rule in use is written down.
verify: Test two rules against the actual triangle output.
Pass when the output behaves as the documented rule states.

steps.title: Document the factor selection and override rules
sop: List the averaging bases considered and the default selection rule.
State when an override is permitted and what note it requires.
Describe the tail selection approach and the benchmark used.
Done when the selection and override rules are fully stated.
verify: Check a sample of current selections against the documented rule.
Pass when every sampled selection complies or carries an override note.

steps.title: Record data limitations and compensating judgements
sop: List known data limitations such as missing history, remaps or coding gaps.
State the judgement applied to compensate for each limitation.
Indicate the likely direction of any resulting bias.
Done when every known limitation has a stated compensating judgement.
verify: Compare the list to the open items on the data issue register.
Pass when no open material data issue is missing from the section.

steps.title: Obtain review and version the document in the model governance repository
sop: Route the draft for peer review and capture the reviewer comments.
Apply the agreed changes and set author, reviewer and effective date.
Check the version into the model governance repository.
Done when the reviewed version is checked in with metadata complete.

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Before and after cohorts reconcile to total open and closed counts for the period.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Quantified distortions are logged with the reserving response chosen.
generic.Test population: All reserving segments served by claims units affected by a handling change.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No quantified distortion may be left without a method or adjustment response.
generic.Exception handling path: An unresolved distortion escalates to the reserve committee as an open assumption item.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Dated list of handling changes obtained and the response recorded in the assumption log.
generic.Evidence location: Assumption log entry plus the before-and-after analysis workbook in Microsoft Excel.

steps.title: Obtain the claims handling change log from Claims
sop: Request case-reserve philosophy, authority limit, caseload, vendor and triage changes.
Record the effective date and affected claims units for each change.
Map the affected units to reserving segments.
Done when the dated change log covers the review period.
verify: Confirm each entry names an effective date and affected units.
Pass when no entry lacks a date or a unit mapping.

steps.title: Test case-reserve adequacy across the change date in Milliman Arius
sop: Compute paid-to-incurred and case adequacy ratios before and after the change date.
Hold accident-year mix constant so the comparison is like for like.
Quantify the shift in adequacy in percentage terms.
Done when the adequacy comparison is produced for each change.
verify: Recompute one adequacy ratio from the claims extract.
Pass when the recomputed ratio matches the comparison exhibit.

steps.title: Compare closure rates and average case reserve in the claims management platform
sop: Pull closure rate and average open case reserve either side of the change date.
Split by claims unit so the change is isolated where possible.
Chart both series against the change date.
Done when both metrics are compared across the change date.
verify: Check the cohorts reconcile to total open and closed counts.
Pass when the cohort counts sum to the period totals.

steps.title: Quantify the distortion to the incurred development pattern in Milliman Arius
sop: Estimate the effect of the handling change on incurred age-to-age factors.
Compare the incurred indication to the paid indication for the affected segments.
Record the dollar effect on the indicated ultimate.
Done when the distortion is quantified per affected segment.
verify: Confirm the paid and incurred runs used the same triangle version.
Pass when both runs cite the same version identifier.

steps.title: Decide the reserving response
sop: Choose between adjusting the triangle, reweighting to a less sensitive method or accepting.
Prefer paid-based or Bornhuetter-Ferguson methods where incurred is distorted.
Apply the chosen response in Milliman Arius for the affected segments.
Done when every quantified distortion has an applied response.
verify: List quantified distortions without an applied response.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Document the change and response in the assumption log
sop: Record the handling change, the evidence and the reserving response.
Cross-reference the adequacy and closure exhibits.
Set a review date to retest once more experience emerges.
Done when the assumption log entry is complete for each change.
verify: Compare log entries to the handling change list.
Pass when every material change has a log entry with a response.

generic.Defined scope/population: Selected cumulative development factors for every mapped reserving segment.
generic.In-scope period: The industry data vintage matching the current evaluation year for each mapped line.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each comparison records segment, mapped line, industry vintage and factor variance.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Company cumulative factors used in the comparison tie to the Arius selection set.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Benchmark exhibit stored with source citation, vintage and evaluation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Persistent divergences are logged with a mix, limits, jurisdiction or practice explanation.
generic.Test population: All reserving segments carrying a selected development pattern this cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No segment may be benchmarked against a line it is not mapped to.
generic.Exception handling path: An unmapped comparison is withdrawn and the segment is remapped before conclusion.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each selection recorded as supported, challenged or inconclusive against the benchmark.
generic.Evidence location: Benchmark comparison exhibit in Microsoft Excel filed in the reserve cycle folder.

steps.title: Load industry development patterns from Statutory Reporting (NAIC)
sop: Download the development pattern for each mapped line and evaluation vintage.
Record the source publication and vintage against each pattern.
Convert the pattern to cumulative factors on the company maturity grain.
Done when a usable industry pattern exists per mapped line.
verify: Recompute one industry cumulative factor from the published age-to-age data.
Pass when the recomputed factor matches the loaded pattern.

steps.title: Chart company against industry factors in Microsoft Excel
sop: Plot company selected cumulative factors against industry at each maturity.
Show the variance in factor points and as a percentage.
Produce one chart per segment.
Done when charts exist for every mapped segment.
verify: Check the company factors used match the Arius selection set.
Pass when the charted factors tie to the locked selections.

steps.title: Quantify the sensitivity of adopting the industry pattern in Milliman Arius
sop: Rerun the indication substituting the industry pattern for the company selection.
Record the change in indicated ultimate by segment.
Note whether the result stays inside the range of reasonable estimates.
Done when the sensitivity result is recorded for every segment.
verify: Confirm only the pattern changed between the two runs.
Pass when the runs differ solely in the development pattern.

steps.title: Explain persistent divergence
sop: Identify segments diverging from industry in the same direction over several cycles.
Attribute the divergence to mix, limits, jurisdiction or claims practice.
Support each attribution with company exposure or claim data.
Done when every persistent divergence has an evidenced explanation.
verify: Check each explanation cites a company data source.
Pass when no explanation rests on assertion alone.

steps.title: Record the benchmark conclusion per selection
sop: Mark each selection as supported, challenged or inconclusive against the benchmark.
Note the action for any challenged selection.
Reference the sensitivity result in the conclusion.
Done when every selection carries a benchmark conclusion.
verify: Count selections without a conclusion.
Pass when that count is zero.

steps.title: File the benchmark exhibit with source citations
sop: Assemble charts, variance table, sensitivity and conclusions into one exhibit.
Cite the industry source and vintage on every page.
File the exhibit in the reserve cycle folder.
Done when the exhibit is filed with full citations.
verify: Check every page carries a source and vintage citation.
Pass when no page lacks a citation.

generic.Defined scope/population: The experience tracking pack and the standing recipients in reserving, pricing, claims and finance.
generic.In-scope period: The current monitoring period at the latest closed evaluation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every exhibit carries evaluation date, triangle version and segment coverage.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exhibit headline figures agree with the source monitoring exhibits and the dashboard.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published pack stored with version and distribution date in the document management repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Exhibits built on a superseded version are withdrawn and logged before distribution.
generic.Test population: All exhibits included in the distributed experience tracking pack.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No exhibit in the pack may be built on a superseded triangle version.
generic.Exception handling path: A version mismatch stops distribution and returns the exhibit for rebuild.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Current-period report published with evaluation date, version and a summary of top movements.
generic.Evidence location: Published pack in the document management repository plus the monitoring register entry.

steps.title: Compile the experience tracking pack in Microsoft Teams / Email ready form
sop: Collect the A-versus-E, link-ratio movement, inventory and exception exhibits.
Order them to follow the standard pack structure.
Remove any exhibit superseded during the cycle.
Done when the pack holds the full standard exhibit set.
verify: Compare pack contents to the standard exhibit list.
Pass when no standard exhibit is missing.

steps.title: Confirm evaluation date and version consistency
sop: Read the evaluation date and triangle version from each exhibit footer.
Compare them across the pack.
Rebuild any exhibit on a different version.
Done when all exhibits share one evaluation date and version.
verify: List distinct version identifiers found in the pack.
Pass when exactly one version identifier appears.

steps.title: Write the one-page summary of top movements
sop: Identify the three most significant experience movements for the period.
State the quantum, the segment and the driver for each.
Keep the language readable for non-actuarial recipients.
Done when the summary page is drafted and attached.
verify: Trace each summary figure back to its exhibit.
Pass when every summary figure ties to an exhibit.

steps.title: Obtain Reserving Actuary review before release
sop: Review the pack and the summary for accuracy and tone.
Challenge any movement description that overstates the evidence.
Approve the pack for distribution or return specific exhibits.
Done when the pack is approved for release.
verify: Check returned exhibits were corrected before release.
Pass when no returned exhibit was distributed uncorrected.

steps.title: Distribute the pack via Microsoft Teams / Email
sop: Send to pricing, claims leadership, planning and finance per the standing list.
Publish the pack to the BI/reporting platform location for self-service access.
Include the summary text in the message body.
Done when all standing recipients have access.
verify: Compare the send record to the standing distribution list.
Pass when every standing recipient is covered.

steps.title: Log the distribution in the monitoring register
sop: Record distribution date, pack version and recipients.
Link the entry to the published pack location.
Note any recipient added or removed this period.
Done when the register entry is complete.
verify: Follow the register link to the published pack.
Pass when the link resolves to the distributed version.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every development pattern change flagged by monitoring this cycle, by segment and maturity.
generic.In-scope period: The current monitoring cycle plus any deferred entries carried forward.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each entry records segment, maturity, effective date, evidence and the decision taken.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Log entry count matches the count of flagged pattern changes from monitoring.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Entries versioned in the model governance repository with the cycle evaluation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deferred entries carry a forward review date rather than being closed.
generic.Test population: All pattern changes flagged in the monitoring exhibits for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No deferred entry may be recorded without a forward review date.
generic.Exception handling path: An entry without evidence is returned to the analyst before the log is finalised.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: An entry exists for every flagged pattern change and cross-references its exhibit.
generic.Evidence location: Assumption change log in the model governance repository with exhibits in Microsoft Excel.

steps.title: Collect flagged pattern changes from the monitoring exhibits
sop: List every pattern change flagged in link-ratio, A-versus-E and closure monitoring.
Record segment, maturity and the period the change was observed.
Remove duplicates raised by more than one exhibit.
Done when the deduplicated flagged list is complete.
verify: Compare the list count to the flags in the source exhibits.
Pass when every distinct flag appears once in the list.

steps.title: Create an assumption log entry per change in the model governance repository
sop: Open one log entry for each flagged change with segment, maturity and effective date.
Use the standard entry template so fields stay comparable across cycles.
Assign an owner to each entry.
Done when every flagged change has an open log entry.
verify: Count flagged changes without a log entry.
Pass when that count is zero.

steps.title: State the evidence and alternatives considered
sop: Write the evidence supporting the observed change in the entry.
Record the alternative explanations considered and why they were set aside.
Reference the claim or data detail where a single item drives the change.
Done when each entry carries evidence and considered alternatives.
verify: Check each entry cites at least one exhibit or data reference.
Pass when no entry lacks a reference.

steps.title: Record the decision taken this cycle
sop: Mark the entry as selection changed, deferred or rejected with the reason.
For changes, note the segments and maturities actually amended.
For rejections, state what evidence would change the decision.
Done when every entry carries a decision and reason.
verify: Cross-check changed entries against the Arius selection set.
Pass when every changed entry matches an applied selection change.

steps.title: Cross-reference each entry to its exhibit in Microsoft Excel
sop: Link each log entry to the exhibit demonstrating the change.
Store the exhibit version alongside the link.
Check the link resolves for a reader outside the reserving team.
Done when every entry links to a retrievable exhibit.
verify: Follow a sample of five links.
Pass when all five resolve to the correct exhibit.

steps.title: Carry unresolved entries forward with a review date
sop: Keep deferred entries open rather than closing them at cycle end.
Set a forward review date and an owner for each deferred entry.
Add deferred entries to the next cycle carry-forward list.
Done when every deferred entry has a review date and owner.
verify: List deferred entries lacking a forward review date.
Pass when that list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: The approved reserve monitoring metric set across all reserving segments.
generic.In-scope period: The current monitoring period plus the prior period for consecutive-breach testing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each breach records metric, segment, limit, actual value, owner and response date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recomputed metric values agree with the dashboard and the source exhibits.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Metric run output saved with the evaluation date and data refresh timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Breaches confirmed as data or timing artefacts are logged and withdrawn with a reason.
generic.Test population: All monitoring metrics computed for the period across every segment.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Any metric breaching two consecutive periods must be escalated.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalated breaches go to the Reserving Actuary with the supporting exhibit.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each breached metric shows limit, actual, owner and due date.
generic.Evidence location: Monitoring exception log in Microsoft Excel plus the BI/reporting platform metric view.

steps.title: Recompute the monitoring metrics in Milliman Arius and Microsoft Excel
sop: Recompute A-versus-E, closure rate, average severity and case adequacy for the period.
Use the current evaluation-date triangle and inventory data.
Record the run date and the data version used.
Done when every metric in the approved set is recomputed.
verify: Compare two recomputed metrics to the BI/reporting platform values.
Pass when the values agree within the stated rounding.

steps.title: Compare each metric to its control limit in Microsoft Excel
sop: Load the approved control limits for each metric and segment.
Mark every value falling outside its limit.
Record the size of the breach in absolute and relative terms.
Done when every metric has been tested against its limit.
verify: Check the limits used match the approved limit schedule.
Pass when every limit matches the schedule.

steps.title: Rule out data and timing artefacts with the Data Analyst
sop: Check each breach for late data loads, partial refreshes or mapping changes.
Rerun the metric after any correction.
Withdraw breaches caused by artefacts and record the reason.
Done when every breach is confirmed genuine or withdrawn.
verify: Rerun the withdrawn breaches after the corrected load.
Pass when withdrawn breaches no longer appear.

steps.title: Assign owner and response date to each breach
sop: Assign a named owner to each confirmed breach.
Set a required response date consistent with the monitoring calendar.
Record the required action in the exception log.
Done when every confirmed breach has an owner and a date.
verify: Count confirmed breaches without an owner or a date.
Pass when that count is zero.

steps.title: Test for consecutive-period breaches
sop: Compare this period breach list to the prior period list.
Identify metrics breaching in both periods for the same segment.
Mark those items for escalation.
Done when consecutive breaches are identified.
verify: Check the prior-period list used is the signed-off version.
Pass when the comparison uses signed-off prior data.

steps.title: Escalate consecutive breaches to the Reserving Analyst review and the actuary
sop: Package the consecutive breaches with their exhibits and history.
Send them to the reserving actuary with a recommended action.
Record the escalation date in the exception log.
Done when every consecutive breach is escalated and logged.
verify: Compare escalated items to the consecutive-breach list.
Pass when no consecutive breach is missing an escalation record.

generic.Defined scope/population: All accident years and segments with expected emergence derived from prior cycle selections.
generic.In-scope period: The current monitoring period measured against the prior cycle evaluation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each accident year records expected, actual, dollar difference and percentage difference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Expected emergence sums reconcile to the prior cycle selected ultimates.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Emergence exhibit saved with both cycle version identifiers and the evaluation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Material deviations are logged and placed on the deeper-review list.
generic.Test population: Every accident year and segment carrying an expectation for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No material deviation may be left off the deeper-review list.
generic.Exception handling path: Deviations concentrated in one segment are routed to the segment deep dive.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Expected emergence derived from prior cycle selections and shown by accident year.
generic.Evidence location: A-versus-E emergence exhibit in Microsoft Excel filed with the monitoring pack.

steps.title: Derive expected emergence from prior selections in Milliman Arius
sop: Load the prior cycle selected patterns and ultimates by accident year.
Compute expected paid and reported emergence for the monitoring period.
Record the derivation so it can be reproduced next cycle.
Done when expected emergence exists for every accident year and segment.
verify: Reconcile the expected emergence sum to the prior selected ultimates.
Pass when the two reconcile within rounding.

steps.title: Compute actual emergence for the period in Milliman Arius
sop: Compute actual paid and reported emergence from the period transactions.
Use the same segment mapping as the expectation.
Export actual and expected side by side to Microsoft Excel.
Done when actual emergence is measured on the same basis as expected.
verify: Tie actual emergence to the quarter claims transaction totals.
Pass when the two agree within tolerance.

steps.title: Compute and rank deviations in Microsoft Excel
sop: Compute the dollar and percentage difference between actual and expected.
Rank accident years by absolute and by relative deviation.
Apply the agreed materiality threshold to the ranking.
Done when the ranked deviation table is complete.
verify: Recompute two deviations from the underlying figures.
Pass when the recomputed values match the table.

steps.title: Test concentration by segment, maturity and claim type in Milliman Arius
sop: Break the deviations down by segment, maturity and claim type.
Identify whether the deviation is broad or concentrated.
Record the concentration finding per material deviation.
Done when each material deviation carries a concentration finding.
verify: Check the breakdown components sum to the total deviation.
Pass when the components reconcile to the total.

steps.title: Compile the deeper-review list
sop: List every accident year and segment exceeding the materiality threshold.
Assign the review owner and the target cycle for the deeper review.
Include prior-period repeats even where this period is below threshold.
Done when the deeper-review list is issued for the cycle.
verify: Compare the list to the material deviations in the ranked table.
Pass when no material deviation is missing from the list.

steps.title: File the emergence exhibit with the monitoring pack
sop: Assemble expectation derivation, actual emergence, ranking and concentration findings.
Stamp the exhibit with both cycle version identifiers.
File it with the quarterly monitoring exhibits.
Done when the exhibit is filed and linked from the pack.
verify: Open the filed exhibit from the pack link.
Pass when the exhibit resolves and carries both version identifiers.

generic.Defined scope/population: Indicated versus booked reserves for every segment considered for strengthening or release.
generic.In-scope period: The current evaluation date compared with the currently booked reserve position.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each recommendation records segment, accident year, quantum, driver and supporting methods.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Segment recommendations sum to the total recommended reserve movement.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Indication run and comparison saved with the evaluation-date version identifier.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Indications not recommended for action are logged with the reason for no change.
generic.Test population: All segments where the indicated reserve differs from booked beyond the action threshold.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No strengthening or release may be recommended on a single method alone.
generic.Exception handling path: A single-method indication is returned for corroboration before it reaches committee.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Recommendation states quantum by segment and accident year with range positioning.
generic.Evidence location: Reserve committee recommendation paper in Microsoft Excel with the Arius run reference.

steps.title: Recalculate indicated ultimates by segment in Milliman Arius
sop: Run the indication for every segment on the current approved triangle version.
Convert indicated ultimates to indicated reserves net of paid.
Record the run identifier and the selections used.
Done when indicated reserves exist for every segment.
verify: Confirm the run used the locked selection set for the cycle.
Pass when the run identifier ties to the locked selections.

steps.title: Compare indicated to booked reserves in Microsoft Excel
sop: Place indicated reserves beside currently booked reserves by segment.
Compute the difference in dollars and as a percentage of booked.
Apply the action threshold to identify candidate segments.
Done when candidate segments are identified.
verify: Tie booked reserves to the general ledger reserve balances.
Pass when booked figures agree with the ledger.

steps.title: Quantify the movement in dollars and loss-ratio points
sop: Express the indicated movement by accident year in dollars.
Convert to loss-ratio points using the approved earned premium base.
Show the effect on the calendar-year result.
Done when both measures exist for every candidate segment.
verify: Check the premium base used is the approved base.
Pass when no loss-ratio figure uses an unapproved base.

steps.title: Corroborate with a second independent method in Milliman Arius
sop: Rerun each candidate segment under at least one further admitted method.
Compare the second indication to the first and record the spread.
Drop or re-scope indications the second method does not support.
Done when every candidate carries at least two method results.
verify: List candidates supported by only one method.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Position the post-change booked reserve within the range
sop: Apply the proposed change and locate the resulting booked reserve in the approved range.
Confirm the position is consistent with the reserving policy.
Note any segment that would sit outside its own range.
Done when the post-change position is stated for every candidate.
verify: Compare the stated position to the approved range record.
Pass when the positions tie to the approved range.

steps.title: Draft the recommendation for reserve committee with the Chief Actuary
sop: Set out driver, quantum and affected segments and accident years.
State the corroborating methods and the range position after the change.
Recommend action, staged action, or monitoring with a trigger.
Done when the recommendation paper is ready for committee.
verify: Check segment quanta sum to the headline recommendation.
Pass when the components reconcile to the total.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every open item on the monitoring carry-forward list for the coming reserve cycle.
generic.In-scope period: The next quarter reserve indication cycle at the following evaluation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each item records segment, action, model object changed and the log reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Model assumption changes reconcile one for one with accepted carry-forward decisions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Model change recorded with the Arius version and the assumption log entry date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items not actioned this cycle are restated with a new review date.
generic.Test population: All carry-forward items reviewed for action in the current cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No accepted change may exist in the model but be missing from the log.
generic.Exception handling path: An unlogged model change is reversed or logged before the indication is released.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Methodology document and assumption log match the applied model changes.
generic.Evidence location: Model governance repository assumption log plus the Arius cycle model version.

steps.title: Open the carry-forward list in the model governance repository
sop: Retrieve all open monitoring items carried into this cycle.
Check each item still has an owner and a review date.
Sort items by segment so related changes are handled together.
Done when the carry-forward list is current and owned.
verify: Compare the list to the prior cycle deferred entries.
Pass when every prior deferred entry appears or is closed with a reason.

steps.title: Decide the action for each item
sop: Decide apply now, defer with a new date, or close with a reason for each item.
Record the evidence that supports applying or deferring.
Assign the model change owner for applied items.
Done when every item carries a decision.
verify: Count items without a decision.
Pass when that count is zero.

steps.title: Update selections and a priori assumptions in Milliman Arius
sop: Apply LDF selection, a priori loss ratio and method weight changes for accepted items.
Change only the segments named in the accepted decisions.
Record the model object changed against each item.
Done when all accepted changes are applied in the model.
verify: Diff the model against the prior cycle version.
Pass when every difference maps to an accepted decision.

steps.title: Rerun affected segments and quantify the change in Milliman Arius
sop: Rerun the indication for every segment touched by a change.
Record the movement in indicated ultimate caused by each change.
Flag any movement larger than expected for a second look.
Done when the impact of each change is quantified.
verify: Confirm the rerun used the current triangle version.
Pass when the version matches the evaluation-date release.

steps.title: Update the methodology document and assumption log
sop: Record each applied change, its basis and its quantified impact in the log.
Update the methodology document where a rule or default changed.
Cross-reference the model version carrying the change.
Done when documentation matches the applied model changes.
verify: Compare the model diff to the log entries.
Pass when every model change has a matching log entry.

steps.title: Close or restate each carry-forward item
sop: Close items whose action has been applied and documented.
Restate deferred items with a new review date and owner.
Publish the updated carry-forward list for the next cycle.
Done when every item is closed or restated with a date.
verify: List items neither closed nor carrying a new review date.
Pass when that list is empty.

generic.Defined scope/population: Calendar-year incurred loss by segment split into current and prior accident-year components.
generic.In-scope period: The current calendar reporting period at the evaluation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each segment row carries calendar-year incurred, current-year loss, prior-year development and residual.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Accident-year components sum back to the calendar-year total for every segment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bridge workbook saved with the triangle version and the ledger close date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Residual items above tolerance are logged with a cause and a correction route.
generic.Test population: All reserving segments included in the calendar-year loss total.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No residual in the bridge above the agreed tolerance.
generic.Exception handling path: An out-of-tolerance residual returns to data reconciliation before the bridge is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Bridge reconciles calendar-year incurred to accident-year components by segment.
generic.Evidence location: Calendar-to-accident-year bridge workbook in Microsoft Excel filed for Finance reporting.

steps.title: Build calendar-year incurred by segment from the enterprise data warehouse/lakehouse
sop: Sum period paid movement and case reserve movement by segment.
Add IBNR movement to reach calendar-year incurred.
Confirm the period matches the ledger reporting period.
Done when calendar-year incurred exists for every segment.
verify: Compare the total to the ledger incurred loss for the period.
Pass when the two agree within tolerance.

steps.title: Split into current and prior accident-year components in Milliman Arius
sop: Separate current accident-year loss from prior accident-year development.
Use the accident period on each transaction rather than a booking allocation.
Show both components by segment.
Done when the split is produced for every segment.
verify: Check the split uses transaction accident periods.
Pass when no component is derived by allocation.

steps.title: Reconcile the accident-year view to the calendar-year total
sop: Sum the accident-year components and compare to the calendar-year total.
List any residual by segment.
Trace residuals to timing, mapping or non-reserving transactions.
Done when the residual is measured and traced for every segment.
verify: Confirm residuals sit within the agreed tolerance.
Pass when no segment residual exceeds tolerance.

steps.title: Chart prior-year development by accident year of origin in Microsoft Excel
sop: Attribute the prior-year development component to its accident year of origin.
Chart the attribution across accident years.
Highlight the accident years contributing most of the movement.
Done when the attribution chart is produced per segment.
verify: Tie the charted attribution total to the prior-year development figure.
Pass when the two agree.

steps.title: Explain the largest contributors to the gap
sop: Identify the largest drivers of the calendar versus accident-year difference.
Attribute each to development, large losses or assumption change.
Write a short explanation per driver for Finance.
Done when the top drivers are explained.
verify: Check each explanation ties to a bridge line item.
Pass when no explanation lacks a bridge reference.

steps.title: Issue the bridge to Finance reporting
sop: Assemble the bridge, the attribution chart and the driver commentary.
Confirm the version and evaluation date on every page.
Issue to financial reporting by the close deadline.
Done when the bridge is issued and acknowledged.
verify: Compare issued figures to the ledger period movement.
Pass when the issued bridge ties to the ledger.

generic.Defined scope/population: The standard quarterly exhibit set plus the segment deep dives selected for this rotation.
generic.In-scope period: The current quarter evaluation date ahead of the reserve committee meeting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each exhibit carries evaluation date, segment coverage and the triangle version used.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Movement bridge reconciles prior quarter booked reserve to the current indication.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Circulated pack stored with the circulation date and version in the reserve cycle folder.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Exhibits omitted from the standard set are logged with the reason for omission.
generic.Test population: All exhibits assembled for the quarterly reserve committee pack.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No pack may be circulated later than the reserve calendar deadline.
generic.Exception handling path: A late pack is escalated to the Reserving Actuary with a revised circulation plan.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Standard exhibit set plus movement bridge present and the prior action list attached.
generic.Evidence location: Quarterly reserve committee pack in the reserve cycle folder in Microsoft Excel.

steps.title: Produce the standard exhibit set in Milliman Arius
sop: Generate indicated versus booked, A-versus-E, link-ratio movement and range position exhibits.
Add the inventory metric exhibit for the quarter.
Export the set to Microsoft Excel in the standard pack layout.
Done when every standard exhibit exists for the quarter.
verify: Compare produced exhibits to the standard exhibit list.
Pass when no standard exhibit is missing.

steps.title: Add the segment deep dives for this rotation
sop: Identify the segments scheduled for deep dive this quarter.
Build the deep-dive exhibits for those segments only.
Note which segments are next in the rotation.
Done when the scheduled deep dives are included.
verify: Compare included deep dives to the rotation schedule.
Pass when the pack matches the schedule.

steps.title: Build the movement bridge in Microsoft Excel
sop: Bridge prior quarter booked reserve to the current indicated reserve.
Show paid movement, expected emergence, actual variance and assumption change.
Confirm the bridge components sum to the total movement.
Done when the bridge reconciles end to end.
verify: Recompute the bridge total from the components.
Pass when the components sum to the observed movement.

steps.title: Attach the open action list from the previous committee
sop: Retrieve the action list from the last reserve committee minute.
Update the status of each action with evidence.
Flag actions overdue for committee attention.
