steps.title: Benchmark the exposure against similar claims in Milliman Arius
sop: Identify comparable closed claims by injury type, venue and coverage.
Derive an indicative severity range from the comparables.
Note where no usable comparable exists.
Done when a benchmark range is derived or its absence noted.
verify: Check the comparables share the key exposure characteristics.
Pass when the comparable set is defensible for the claim.

steps.title: Set the indemnity and expense components
sop: Set the indemnity reserve with the exposure basis stated.
Set the expense reserve separately covering defence and allocated expense.
Cap components at policy limits where applicable.
Done when both components are set with a stated basis.
verify: Check both components exist and neither exceeds the policy limit.
Pass when components are separate and within limits.

steps.title: Confirm authority and route for approval
sop: Compare the total reserve to the setter authority limit.
Route over-limit reserves for the required approval before posting.
Record the approver and the approval date.
Done when authority is confirmed or approval obtained.
verify: List reserves above the limit and check for approvals.
Pass when every over-limit reserve has a recorded approval.

steps.title: Record the rationale and review trigger in the claim file
sop: Write the reserve rationale, key assumptions and the benchmark used.
State the trigger that would require a reserve review.
Store the note in the claim file rather than a personal workbook.
Done when the rationale is in the claim file.
verify: Open the claim file and read the rationale note.
Pass when rationale and trigger are both present.

steps.title: Confirm posting to the correct period and segment
sop: Check the accident period and reserving segment on the posted transaction.
Correct any misposting before the period close.
Reconcile the posted reserves to the large-loss schedule.
Done when postings are correct and reconciled.
verify: Reconcile the claims platform balance to the large-loss schedule.
Pass when the two agree for the claims listed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Open claims approaching or exceeding per-occurrence or aggregate treaty attachment points.
generic.In-scope period: All applicable underwriting years with treaties in force for the exposed claims.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each flagged claim records treaty year, program, attachment point and notification status.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Flagged claim incurred totals reconcile to the claims platform incurred values.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Attachment point load and screening output saved with the evaluation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims mapped to the wrong treaty year are corrected and the correction logged.
generic.Test population: All open claims screened against the loaded attachment points.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No claim past a treaty notification threshold without a recorded notification.
generic.Exception handling path: A missed notification is issued immediately and the delay is logged with the broker.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Current attachment points loaded for each applicable underwriting year before screening.
generic.Evidence location: Treaty repository attachment schedule plus the screening output in the reinsurance administration system.

steps.title: Load current attachment points from the treaty repository
sop: Load attachment points, limits and reporting thresholds by underwriting year.
Include aggregate deductibles and corridor features.
Record the treaty document version used.
Done when attachment data is loaded for every applicable year.
verify: Compare loaded values to the treaty slips for two programs.
Pass when the loaded values match the slips.

steps.title: Screen open claims in the claims management platform
sop: Select open claims where incurred plus expected development nears the attachment.
Apply the expected development factor for the claim maturity.
Produce the candidate list with incurred and projected values.
Done when the candidate list is produced for every program.
verify: Recompute the projection for the three largest candidates.
Pass when the recomputed projections match the list.

steps.title: Confirm treaty year and program mapping
sop: Check each candidate maps to the correct underwriting year and program.
Resolve claims whose policy year and treaty year differ.
Correct mismapped claims before flagging.
Done when every candidate has a confirmed treaty mapping.
verify: Sample five mappings against the policy and treaty records.
Pass when all five mappings are correct.

steps.title: Issue or confirm reinsurer notification in the reinsurance administration system
sop: Check whether notification has already been issued for each flagged claim.
Issue notification for claims past the threshold within the treaty period.
Record the notification date and reference.
Done when every threshold claim has a notification record.
verify: List threshold claims without a notification reference.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Add flagged claims to the ceded reserve input list
sop: Add the flagged claims with incurred and projected values to the ceded input list.
Note the treaty layer each claim is expected to reach.
Hand the list to the ceded reserve estimate step.
Done when the ceded input list includes every flagged claim.
verify: Compare the input list to the flagged claim list.
Pass when the lists match.

steps.title: Record the screening run and its parameters
sop: Record the run date, attachment data version and development factors used.
File the screening output with the reinsurance working papers.
Set the next screening date.
Done when the run is recorded and filed.
verify: Open the filed output and check the parameters are recorded.
Pass when the run parameters are fully documented.

generic.Defined scope/population: Aggregate latent liability exposure across policy years with occurrence or claims-made triggers.
generic.In-scope period: All policy years with potential latent exposure at the current evaluation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Inputs record policy counts, limits, coverage trigger and known claimant populations.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Method results and selected estimate reconcile to the stated method weights.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Model run, parameters and outputs stored with the model version and evaluation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Methods run but rejected are logged with the reason for rejection.
generic.Test population: All latent exposure classes modelled for the evaluation date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No selected estimate without documented method weights.
generic.Exception handling path: A single-method estimate is returned for a second approach before selection.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: At least two method results and the selected estimate recorded for the evaluation date.
generic.Evidence location: Actuarial modeling platform run record plus the latent estimate workbook in Microsoft Excel.

steps.title: Assemble exposure inputs in Microsoft Excel
sop: Collect policy counts by year, limits and the occurrence or claims-made basis.
Add the known claimant population and its reporting history.
Note gaps where historical policy records are incomplete.
Done when the exposure input set is assembled with gaps noted.
verify: Reconcile policy counts to the policy record archive where available.
Pass when the counts agree or the gap is documented.

steps.title: Run the survival ratio approach in Milliman Arius
sop: Compute paid and incurred survival ratios for the latent classes.
Compare implied survival to the benchmark survival ratio for the industry.
Record the resulting indicated reserve.
Done when the survival ratio indication is produced.
verify: Recompute one survival ratio from the paid history.
Pass when the recomputed ratio matches the model output.

steps.title: Run the exposure or frequency-severity approach in the Actuarial modeling platform
sop: Project claimant counts over the modelled horizon.
Apply the average severity assumption and expense loading.
Record the resulting indicated reserve.
Done when the exposure-based indication is produced.
verify: Check the claimant projection against the observed reporting trend.
Pass when the projection is consistent with observed reporting.

steps.title: Test sensitivity to horizon and severity
sop: Vary the claimant projection horizon across the agreed sensitivity set.
Vary the average severity assumption across the agreed sensitivity set.
Record the indicated reserve under each variation.
Done when sensitivities are recorded for both drivers.
verify: Check each sensitivity changed only one driver.
Pass when no sensitivity confounds two drivers.

steps.title: Compare results to industry benchmarks
sop: Compare the indicated ultimate and implied survival ratio to industry benchmarks.
Explain divergence by exposure profile, limits or coverage trigger.
Record the benchmark source and vintage.
Done when the benchmark comparison is documented.
verify: Check the benchmark cited matches the exposure class modelled.
Pass when the benchmark is appropriate to the class.

steps.title: Select the estimate and document weights
sop: Weight the method results and select the aggregate latent estimate.
Document the weights and the key judgements behind them.
Store the run identifier, parameters and outputs for review.
Done when the selected estimate and weights are documented.
verify: Recompute the selected estimate from the results and weights.
Pass when the recomputation reproduces the selected estimate.

generic.Defined scope/population: All claims whose incurred crosses the large-loss reporting threshold in the period.
generic.In-scope period: The current reporting period compared with the prior period large-loss population.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each claim records incurred, segment, accident period, coverage status and entry or exit flag.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Large-loss population totals reconcile to the claims platform incurred values.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Period report saved with the snapshot identifier and report run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims moving back below threshold are logged with the movement reason.
generic.Test population: All claims tested against the large-loss reporting threshold for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No new large-loss entrant may be missing from the reserve review queue.
generic.Exception handling path: A missed entrant is added to the queue immediately and the gap is logged.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Period report lists new entrants and exits with incurred values.
generic.Evidence location: Large-loss period report on the BI/reporting platform with the warehouse extract.

steps.title: Run the threshold breach report on the BI/reporting platform
sop: Run the period report of claims crossing the large-loss reporting threshold.
Use the current approved threshold for each segment.
Record the snapshot identifier used.
Done when the breach report is produced for the period.
verify: Compare the report threshold to the approved threshold schedule.
Pass when the thresholds match.

steps.title: Identify entrants and exits since the prior period
sop: Compare the current population to the prior period population.
Flag new entrants and claims that fell back below the threshold.
Record the incurred movement driving each change.
Done when entrants and exits are identified with movements.
verify: Recount entrants and exits against the two populations.
Pass when the counts reconcile to the population change.

steps.title: Check new entrants in the claims management platform
sop: Confirm coverage position, reserving segment and accident period for each entrant.
Correct any misclassification before the claim enters the review.
Note claims with a disputed coverage position.
Done when every entrant has been checked.
verify: Sample three entrants against the claim file detail.
Pass when all three checks hold.

steps.title: Route entrants to the large-loss reserve review queue
sop: Add each new entrant to the large-loss reserve review queue.
Include incurred value, coverage note and accident period.
Confirm the queue owner has accepted the items.
Done when every entrant is in the review queue.
verify: Compare the queue contents to the entrant list.
Pass when no entrant is missing from the queue.

steps.title: Reconcile the population to the enterprise data warehouse/lakehouse
sop: Sum large-loss population incurred by segment.
Compare to the claims system incurred for the same claim set.
Investigate any difference before publishing.
Done when the population reconciles to the claims system.
verify: Recompute the population total from the warehouse extract.
Pass when the totals agree exactly.

steps.title: Publish the period large-loss report
sop: Review entrants, exits and the reconciliation.
Publish the report to the standing audience on the BI/reporting platform.
Record the publication date and version.
Done when the report is published for the period.
verify: Open the published report and check entrant and exit sections are populated.
Pass when both sections appear with incurred values.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded ultimate and ceded IBNR by segment and treaty year at the evaluation date.
generic.In-scope period: All underwriting years with treaties responding to the gross ultimate.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each treaty year records structure applied, ceded ultimate, known cessions and ceded IBNR.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Gross less ceded equals the net ultimate and ties to the ledger ceded reserve balance.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Cession workings saved with the gross ultimate version and evaluation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Treaty features not modelled are logged with the estimated effect.
generic.Test population: All segments and treaty years included in the ceded reserve estimate.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Difference between gross minus ceded and the net ultimate stays within tolerance.
generic.Exception handling path: An out-of-tolerance difference returns the cession workings for correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Ceded ultimate split between known cessions and ceded IBNR with assumptions documented.
generic.Evidence location: Ceded reserve workbook in Microsoft Excel with the ceded accounting platform reconciliation.

steps.title: Load treaty structures by underwriting year in the ceded accounting platform
sop: Load attachment, limit, share and aggregate features for each treaty year.
Note reinstatement provisions and corridor or aggregate deductible features.
Record the treaty document version used.
Done when structures are loaded for every applicable year.
verify: Compare loaded structures to the treaty slips for two years.
Pass when the loaded terms match the slips.

steps.title: Apply treaty structures to the gross ultimate in Milliman Arius
sop: Apply each treaty structure to the gross ultimate by segment and treaty year.
Derive the ceded ultimate on the same segmentation as gross.
Record the version of the gross ultimate used.
Done when ceded ultimate exists for every segment and treaty year.
verify: Check the gross ultimate version matches the current cycle release.
Pass when the versions agree.

steps.title: Split ceded between known cessions and ceded IBNR in Microsoft Excel
sop: Identify cessions attributable to known large losses.
Derive ceded IBNR as the balance of the ceded ultimate.
Show the split by segment and treaty year.
Done when the split is produced for every treaty year.
verify: Add the two components and compare to the ceded ultimate.
Pass when the components sum to the ceded ultimate.

steps.title: Reflect reinstatement and aggregate effects
sop: Compute reinstatement premium triggered by the projected cessions.
Reflect aggregate deductible and corridor erosion in the cession.
Record the assumptions applied for each feature.
Done when reinstatement and aggregate effects are reflected.
verify: Recompute reinstatement for one treaty from the slip terms.
Pass when the recomputed amount matches the workings.

steps.title: Reconcile gross, ceded and net with the Reserving Actuary
sop: Subtract ceded from gross and compare to the net ultimate.
Compare the ceded reserve to the ledger ceded balance.
Investigate any difference beyond tolerance.
Done when the three-way reconciliation holds.
verify: Recompute gross minus ceded for every segment.
Pass when the result matches the net ultimate within tolerance.

steps.title: Document the cession assumptions per treaty year
sop: Record the structure applied and the judgements made for each treaty year.
Note features not modelled and their estimated effect.
File the workings with the reinsurance working papers.
Done when assumptions are documented for every treaty year.
verify: Check each treaty year has a documented assumption note.
Pass when no treaty year lacks documentation.

generic.Defined scope/population: All large-loss claims with activity in the month plus new large losses reported.
generic.In-scope period: The current calendar month at the month-end claims snapshot.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each claim row carries opening incurred, movement, closing incurred, status and explanation.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Opening plus movement equals closing incurred for every claim on the schedule.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Monthly schedule saved with the snapshot identifier and issue date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Movements above the reporting threshold without an explanation are chased and logged.
generic.Test population: All large-loss claims on the monthly schedule.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No movement above the reporting threshold may be issued without an explanation.
generic.Exception handling path: An unexplained movement holds the item open and is escalated in the open item list.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Monthly schedule issued by the deadline with movement explanations and an open item list.
generic.Evidence location: Monthly large-loss report in Microsoft Excel issued via Microsoft Teams / Email.

steps.title: Produce the monthly large-loss schedule on the BI/reporting platform
sop: List each large-loss claim with opening incurred, movement, closing incurred and status.
Use the month-end snapshot for both ends of the movement.
Record the snapshot identifier on the schedule.
Done when the schedule covers every large-loss claim.
verify: Check opening plus movement equals closing for every row.
Pass when the arithmetic holds on every row.

steps.title: Explain movements above the reporting threshold
sop: Identify movements above the reporting threshold.
Obtain the claim handler view on the reason for each movement.
Record the explanation against the claim row.
Done when every threshold movement carries an explanation.
verify: List threshold movements without an explanation.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: List new large losses reported in the month
sop: List claims newly reaching large-loss status in the month.
Record the initial reserve and the coverage position for each.
Flag any claim with a disputed coverage position.
Done when new large losses are listed with reserve and coverage.
verify: Compare the new-loss list to the threshold breach report.
Pass when both lists agree.

steps.title: Show the effect on the segment reserve position in Microsoft Excel
sop: Aggregate large-loss movement by reserving segment.
Compare the movement to the segment reserve and to expected emergence.
Highlight segments where large-loss movement dominates the period.
Done when the segment effect is shown for every affected segment.
verify: Tie the aggregated movement to the claim-level schedule.
Pass when the aggregate matches the claim detail.

steps.title: Compile the open item list
sop: List claims with unresolved coverage, reserve or reinsurance questions.
Assign an owner and a target resolution date to each item.
Carry forward unresolved items from the prior month with their age.
Done when the open item list is complete.
verify: Compare the list to the prior month open items.
Pass when every prior item is closed or carried with an age.

steps.title: Issue the report to the Chief Actuary by the deadline
sop: Review the schedule, explanations and open item list.
Confirm the report is issued by the monthly deadline.
Record any direction given for the following month.
Done when the report is issued and reviewed.
verify: Compare the issue date to the monthly deadline.
Pass when issue precedes the deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: Attritional and large-loss triangle components for every reserving segment.
generic.In-scope period: All accident periods in the evaluation-date triangle set.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Both components carry segment, accident period, development age and measure type.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Attritional plus large-loss equals the total triangle in every cell.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Both component sets stored under the evaluation-date version tag.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims reclassified during the split are logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: Every cell of the split triangles for all reserving segments.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No large-loss amount may remain inside the attritional triangle.
generic.Exception handling path: A residual large-loss amount triggers a rebuild of both components.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Both triangles exist per segment on the same grain and reconcile to total.
generic.Evidence location: Arius split triangle set plus the reconciliation sheet in Microsoft Excel.

steps.title: Remove large-loss amounts from the total triangle in Milliman Arius
sop: Apply the approved large-loss claim list to the total triangle.
Remove the claim amounts to leave the attritional component.
Apply the removal consistently across all accident years.
Done when the attritional triangle exists for every segment.
verify: Check the removed amounts equal the large-loss claim totals.
Pass when the removals tie to the claim list.

steps.title: Build the large-loss triangle on the same grain
sop: Build the large-loss component on the same accident and maturity grain.
Include paid and incurred measures for the component.
Tag it with the same evaluation-date version.
Done when the large-loss triangle exists for every segment.
verify: Compare grains between the two components.
Pass when both components share the same grain.

steps.title: Prove the components sum to total in Microsoft Excel
sop: Add attritional and large-loss cell by cell.
Difference the sum against the total triangle.
Investigate any non-zero cell difference.
Done when the sum equals the total in every cell.
verify: Run the cell-level difference report across all segments.
Pass when the report returns no differences.

steps.title: Derive attritional development factors in Milliman Arius
sop: Compute age-to-age factors on the attritional triangle.
Compare factor volatility to the total triangle factors.
Record the volatility reduction achieved by the split.
Done when attritional factors and the volatility comparison exist.
verify: Recompute one attritional factor from the component triangle.
Pass when the recomputed factor matches Arius.

steps.title: Set the projection approach for the large-loss component
sop: Choose frequency-severity or separate development for the large-loss component.
State why the chosen approach suits the claim volume and volatility.
Record the choice per segment.
Done when every segment has a large-loss projection approach.
verify: Check each choice against the segment large-loss claim count.
Pass when the approach is supportable at that volume.

steps.title: Release the split triangle set under the version tag
sop: Review the reconciliation and the factor comparison.
Release both components under the evaluation-date version tag.
Note the split in the cycle change log.
Done when the split set is released for use.
verify: Open the released set and check both components carry the tag.
Pass when both components share the released tag.

generic.Defined scope/population: IBNR loading factors for latent exposures across affected segments and accident-year cohorts.
generic.In-scope period: The current evaluation date compared with the loading currently carried.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each loading records segment, cohort, prior loading, revised loading and the basis.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Allocated loading across segments sums to the total latent indication.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Revised loading stored with the latent model run identifier and approval reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments where the loading was reviewed but not changed are logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: All segments and cohorts carrying a latent IBNR loading.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No change in loading may be applied without a quantified impact statement.
generic.Exception handling path: An unquantified change is held until the impact is computed and approved.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Updated loading recorded with basis and approval reference in the assumption log.
generic.Evidence location: Assumption log entry plus the loading allocation workbook and the Arius reserve run.

steps.title: Compare the latent model indication to the carried loading in Milliman Arius
sop: Retrieve the current latent model indication for the evaluation date.
Compare it to the IBNR loading currently carried by segment.
Quantify the gap in dollars and as a percentage.
Done when the gap is quantified for every affected segment.
verify: Check the model indication cited matches the approved latent run.
Pass when the run identifier matches the approved run.

steps.title: Allocate the revised loading across segments and cohorts
sop: Allocate the revised loading on the agreed exposure basis.
Split across accident-year cohorts consistently with the exposure profile.
Show the allocation basis alongside the result.
Done when the allocation covers every affected cohort.
verify: Sum the allocated loading and compare to the total indication.
Pass when the allocation sums to the total.

steps.title: Quantify the dollar and net reserve impact in the Actuarial modeling platform
sop: Apply the revised loading and rerun the affected reserve segments.
Record the change in gross and net reserve position.
State the effect on the total reserve and on surplus.
Done when the impact statement is complete.
verify: Confirm only the loading changed between the runs.
Pass when the impact is attributable to the loading alone.

steps.title: Check consistency with the latent reinsurance assumption
sop: Compare the revised gross loading to the assumed latent reinsurance recovery.
Confirm the recovery assumption still holds at the revised gross level.
Adjust the net position where the recovery would be exhausted.
Done when gross and net assumptions are consistent.
verify: Recompute the net loading from gross less assumed recovery.
Pass when the recomputed net matches the applied net loading.

steps.title: Obtain approval for the revised loading
sop: Present the revised loading, its basis and the quantified impact for approval.
Record the approver and the approval date.
Hold the change if approval is not granted.
Done when the approval decision is recorded.
verify: Check the approval record names an approver and a date.
Pass when both are present before the loading is applied.

steps.title: Apply the loading and update the assumption log
sop: Apply the approved loading in Milliman Arius for the affected segments.
Record the new loading, its basis and the approval reference in the assumption log.
Set the review date for the next reassessment.
Done when the model and the log both reflect the approved loading.
verify: Compare the applied loading to the assumption log entry.
Pass when the two match exactly.

generic.Defined scope/population: Development quantification, attribution exhibits, commentary and the prior evaluation-date extract.
generic.In-scope period: The current reporting period prior-year development analysis.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each archived item carries evaluation date, reporting period and version identifier.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived exhibit figures match the figures published in the reporting pack.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archive indexed by evaluation date with the decision note attached.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items excluded from the archive are logged with the reason for exclusion.
generic.Test population: All artefacts produced by the prior-year development analysis for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No archived exhibit may differ from the published reporting figures.
generic.Exception handling path: A mismatch returns the exhibit for correction before archiving is confirmed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Exhibits, base extract and decision note archived and indexed for the period.
generic.Evidence location: Document management repository archive folder plus the model governance repository record.

steps.title: Collect the development analysis artefacts
sop: Gather the quantification, attribution exhibits and final commentary as presented.
Confirm each is the version that went into the reporting pack.
Discard superseded drafts.
Done when the presented versions are collected.
verify: Compare collected versions to the reporting pack contents.
Pass when the versions match the pack.

steps.title: Include the prior evaluation-date reserve extract
sop: Add the prior evaluation-date reserve extract used as the comparison base.
Record its extract identifier and control totals.
Confirm it is the extract used in the quantification.
Done when the base extract is included with its identifier.
verify: Compare the extract identifier to the quantification working paper.
Pass when the identifiers match.

steps.title: Attach the reserve committee decision note
sop: Retrieve the committee minute or decision note relating to the development.
Attach it to the archive set.
Note any action arising that remains open.
Done when the decision note is attached.
verify: Check the note covers the development discussed this period.
Pass when the note matches the period under archive.

steps.title: Verify archived exhibits against published figures
sop: Compare headline figures in the archived exhibits to the reporting pack.
List and correct any difference before confirming the archive.
Record the verification in the archive index.
Done when every archived figure matches the published figure.
verify: Re-perform the comparison on the corrected items.
Pass when no archived exhibit differs from the published figures.

steps.title: Index the archive in the document management repository
sop: Index by evaluation date and reporting period.
Record the contents list and the retention class.
Link the index entry from the statutory filing documentation.
Done when the archive is retrievable by evaluation date.
verify: Retrieve the archive using the index only.
Pass when the retrieval succeeds and contents match the list.

steps.title: Register the archive in the model governance repository
sop: Register the analysis version and its inputs in the model governance record.
Link the record to the archive folder.
Confirm the record is visible to reviewers and auditors.
Done when the governance record is created and linked.
verify: Open the governance record and follow the archive link.
Pass when the link resolves to the archive folder.

generic.Defined scope/population: Prior-year development history by segment over at least the last eight quarters.
generic.In-scope period: The trailing eight quarters ending at the current evaluation date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each quarter and segment records development amount, sign and the method in force.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Quarterly development amounts reconcile to the published development quantifications.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bias analysis workbook saved with the evaluation date and peer reviewer name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Segments with persistent bias are logged with a remediation recommendation.
generic.Test population: All reserving segments with at least eight quarters of development history.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No segment with persistent one-direction development may lack a remediation recommendation.
generic.Exception handling path: A missing remediation returns the analysis to the actuary before peer review closes.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Eight-quarter directional history shown by segment with a peer-reviewed conclusion.
generic.Evidence location: Estimation bias analysis workbook in Microsoft Excel filed with the cycle working papers.

steps.title: Assemble the eight-quarter development history in Milliman Arius
sop: Pull published prior-year development by segment for the last eight quarters.
Record the sign and magnitude for each quarter.
Note quarters affected by one-off events.
Done when the history is assembled for every segment.
verify: Reconcile each quarter to the published development quantification.
Pass when every quarter ties to its published figure.

steps.title: Test for directional consistency in Microsoft Excel
sop: Count same-direction quarters per segment and compare to a random expectation.
Compute the run length of consecutive same-direction quarters.
Flag segments where the pattern is unlikely to be random.
Done when every segment is tested for directional consistency.
verify: Recompute the run lengths for two flagged segments.
Pass when the recomputed runs match the analysis.

steps.title: Separate method bias from a priori bias in Milliman Arius
sop: Decompose development into method selection effect and a priori loss ratio effect.
Attribute the directional error between the two sources.
Note where the data cannot separate the sources.
Done when the decomposition is produced for flagged segments.
verify: Check the decomposed components sum to the observed development.
Pass when the components reconcile.

steps.title: Quantify average directional error and trend
sop: Compute the average directional error per segment over the window.
Chart the trend to show whether the bias is narrowing or widening.
Express the error in dollars and in loss-ratio points.
Done when the error and trend are quantified per segment.
verify: Recompute the average error for the largest segment.
Pass when the recomputed value matches the workbook.

steps.title: Recommend remediation for biased segments
sop: Recommend a method, weighting or a priori change for each biased segment.
State the expected effect of the remediation.
Set the review point to test whether the bias corrects.
Done when every biased segment has a recommendation.
verify: List biased segments without a recommendation.
Pass when that list is empty.

steps.title: Obtain peer review of the conclusion
sop: Route the analysis and conclusions for peer review.
Record reviewer comments and the resolution of each.
Record the reviewer name and date on the final version.
Done when the peer-reviewed conclusion is filed.
verify: Check the filed version names the reviewer and the date.
Pass when both are recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Total prior-year development decomposed into driver categories for every segment.
generic.In-scope period: The current reporting period prior-year development.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each driver row records segment, category, dollar contribution and the evidence reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Attribution components sum to the total reported development for each segment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Attribution table saved with the development quantification version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unattributed residual is logged with the reason it could not be decomposed.
generic.Test population: All segments carrying prior-year development in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No driver category may be recorded without supporting evidence.
generic.Exception handling path: An unevidenced driver is returned for support before the commentary is drafted.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Attribution components sum to total development and the top three drivers are named.
generic.Evidence location: Attribution table in Microsoft Excel filed with the development commentary working papers.

steps.title: Decompose development into driver categories in Milliman Arius

generic.Test population: All closure and inventory metrics published for the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No unexplained count difference above the agreed tolerance.
generic.Exception handling path: An unexplained difference blocks publication until reconciled with claims.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Signed reconciliation between reserving and claims operational counts before publication.
generic.Evidence location: Signed reconciliation workbook in Microsoft Excel with both source extracts referenced.

steps.title: Extract claims operational counts from the claims management platform
sop: Extract the claims operational reporting counts at the reserving cut-off.
Record the extract identifier and the report definitions used.
Confirm the cut-off matches the reserving evaluation date.
Done when the operational counts are extracted at the matching cut-off.
verify: Compare the cut-off dates on both extracts.
Pass when the dates match.

steps.title: Place reserving and claims counts side by side in Microsoft Excel
sop: Align reserving closure and inventory counts against the claims counts.
Align by segment and by count type.
List every non-zero difference.
Done when the comparison covers every published metric.
verify: Check every published metric appears in the comparison.
Pass when none is missing.

steps.title: Identify definition differences
sop: Identify feature versus claim counting, reopen treatment and zero-payment closures.
Check segment mapping differences between the two reporting sets.
Attribute each difference to a definition cause.
Done when every difference has a definition cause or is unexplained.
verify: Test one attributed difference by recomputing on the other definition.
Pass when the recomputation closes the difference.

steps.title: Quantify each difference and the residual
sop: Quantify each definition difference in count terms.
Compute the residual after explained differences.
Compare the residual to the agreed tolerance.
Done when the residual is quantified and compared.
verify: Re-add the explained differences and compare to the gross difference.
Pass when the explained items sum to the gross difference less residual.

steps.title: Agree the authoritative definition with Claims
sop: Agree with claims which definition is authoritative for each metric.
Record the agreement so future periods use one definition.
Note where reserving must continue on a different basis and why.
Done when the authoritative definition is agreed per metric.
verify: Check each metric has one agreed authoritative definition.
Pass when no metric has two competing definitions.

steps.title: Obtain sign-off before the metrics are published
sop: Route the reconciliation for sign-off with the difference schedule.
Confirm the residual is within tolerance before signing.
File the signed reconciliation with the working papers.
Done when the signed reconciliation is filed.
verify: Check the sign-off date precedes the metric publication date.
Pass when sign-off precedes publication.
